requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and structurally atomic. Decomposed into a functional requirement (sending the email) and a quality requirement (delivery time constraint) per Pohl §25.2–25.3 to separate the action from the performance criterion.

source_fragments: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer.
structured_requirements.final_statement: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action. The delivery time constraint was moved to a separate quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The confirmation email shall be delivered within 30 seconds of order submission.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality criterion (delivery time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
